name: Proofpoint - Same user receiving multiple risky emails
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "message-blocked"
| filter classification = "PHISHING"
| comp count(GUID) as email_count,
        values(subject) as subjects,
        values(senderIP) as sender_ips
        by recipient
| filter email_count >= 3
description: The same recipient was targeted by 3+ risky (phishing) emails within the window - a user being singled out for repeated phishing.
alert_name: Proofpoint - Same user receiving multiple risky emails
alert_description:
What fired: one recipient received >=3 phishing emails (blocked) within the window - repeated targeting of a single user.

Why it matters: a user hit repeatedly is likely a deliberate target (VIP / finance / etc.); attackers vary lures until one lands.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped recipient and the set of subjects / sender IPs on this alert.
  - Check whether any of the messages were DELIVERED (not blocked) or clicked.
  - Consider tightening protection / awareness for that user.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1566 - Phishing (TA0001 - Initial Access).
